question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Tropical forests have ________ greenery.
solution:
The correct answer is '**lush**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**lush**" means something very green and healthy, usually used to describe vegetation that is thick and abundant. (हरा-भरा)
